title: Бейсбольная бита
description: Baseball bats were once used in the sport of baseball, considered America's number-one pastime during the pre-War era. Two hundred years later, they have been re-purposed as crude but effective melee weapons. While most are made a single piece of wood-normally ash, but other hardwoods are often used a few can be found made of aluminum instead, making for a lighter, harder bat.
